featureBody: Whitelands Animal Hospital is also an accredited AAHA veterinary hospital. What does this mean? The American Animal Hospital Association accredits veterinary hospitals, to make sure pets receive the best care possible. AAHA is at the heart of better care for pets and their people, and we operate our business with that same mission every day.
